hooks.name: contract-schema-sync
hooks.description: Regenerates the JSON Schemas and the TypeScript types when a contract model changes. No-op until the export module exists (adapter-contract task 2).

hooks.name: adapter-contract-offline
hooks.description: Runs the offline contract checks for the tutor whose adapter changed. No-op until the contract kit exists (adapter-contract task 9).

hooks.name: new-action-integration
hooks.description: When a new adapter action file is created, wires it into its tutor: registry, risk, undo, contract fixture, README. Mirrors the gesture auto-integration hooks of Kiro InteractionKit.

action.prompt: A new adapter action file was just created. Integrate it into its tutor without touching Wysp Core. Skip this if the file is __init__.py, index.ts, a registry or a test file. Steps: (1) make sure the file defines exactly one action whose id equals the file name (<verb>_<object>), with a title, a description written for the LLM, a JSON Schema for its params, a risk level, postconditions using ${params.*} placeholders and, when it helps the learner, guide.ui_path; (2) register it in the adapter's action registry so that adapter.get_actions returns it; (3) if it is reversible, implement undo and make sure it restores the state digest; (4) add at least one safe call and one invalid call for it in apps/<tutor>/contract.fixture.yaml; (5) add a row (id, risk, reversible, description) to the action table of apps/<tutor>/README.md; (6) run `uv run --no-project python scripts/kiro/hook.py contract` and fix failures. Finish by listing the files you changed.
